lines.quote: Designed and implemented the phased-array beamforming engine for Fenno's second-generation maritime radar (2012–2015): frequency-domain beamforming, adaptive null steering for interference rejection, and gain/phase calibration for a 32-element uniform linear array.
Own the embedded firmware running on a Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ SoC — range compression, CFAR detection, azimuth integration, and target extraction, all in C.
in 2019 I rewrote Fenno's offline radar data analysis toolkit from a collection of ad-hoc MATLAB scripts into a structured Python package.
it is now about 9,000 lines, used by the entire signal processing group (six engineers)

RF measurement and calibration: regular use of R&S ZVA67 and Keysight PNA-X for S-parameter, noise-figure, and group-delay measurements; antenna pattern verification in Fenno's anechoic chamber; have maintained the company's RF calibration procedures since 2010

requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: MSc Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science
my degree is in metallurgical engineering, not electrical engineering or physics
the distance between my formal education and my working competence has been closed by the work itself

requirements.note: Candidate explicitly states the degree is not in one of the requirement's named fields and argues for the requirement's alternative route ('demonstrated equivalent competence without one'); both statements quoted, unresolved as to sufficiency.

lines.quote: designed an IMM (interacting multiple model) tracker for the maritime radar's target tracking subsystem, combining constant-velocity and coordinated-turn models with adaptive model-probability transitions; tracker deployed in production since 2018

since 2016 I have been the de facto technical lead for the maritime radar signal processing team — four engineers reporting to me, with responsibility for task allocation, design reviews, and integration milestones.
EU work authorisation: Finnish citizen (naturalised 2008); hold dual Finnish-Indian citizenship
Fenno's engineering team operates entirely in English — design documents, code reviews, specifications, customer-facing acceptance-test reports.
Based in Oulu since 2001; relocated from India to take the original position.
